name: creative-mask-clippath
blurb: Images clipped into custom organic shapes using SVG clip-path.
description: Gallery grid displaying images masked by SVG clipPath definitions in objectBoundingBox units. Each image scales on hover, with clipping shapes defined in SVG defs.
use_when: Showcasing a gallery with distinctive, brand-aligned shape cutouts without animation.
avoid_when: When clipped content must animate or handle complex gestures — SVG clipPath is static.
a11y: Renders `` tags with empty alt attributes; SVG clipPath is a passive shape layer.
